title: Inner product of the ±1 embedding with the all-ones vector
statement:
Let $x$ be a binary word of length $n$, and let $s(x) \in \bbr^n$ denote its $\pm1$ embedding, the vector whose $i$-th coordinate is $-1$ at each position where $x_i$ is set and $+1$ elsewhere. Writing $\mathbf{1}$ for the all-ones vector and $\mathrm{wt}(x)$ for the Hamming weight of $x$ (the number of positions at which $x$ is set), the $\ell^2$ inner product satisfies
\[
\langle s(x), \mathbf{1} \rangle = n - 2\,\mathrm{wt}(x).
\]
hypotheses_covered: x is a binary word of length n
